researchNotes:
SCOPE: district-run, club and university pools in Budapest, deliberately EXCLUDING the colleague's set (Komjádi, Hajós Alfréd Margitsziget, Gellért, Széchenyi, Lukács, Palatinus, Dagály, Duna Aréna, Tüskecsarnok). Research performed 2026-09-24.

METHOD. Coordinates were obtained from a single bulk OpenStreetMap Overpass query over the Budapest admin area (126 candidate features: name, lat/lon, addr:* tags, website, phone, opening_hours) and then cross-checked, one pool at a time, against the street address printed on the operator's own contact page. A coordinate was accepted ONLY when the two agreed; otherwise it would have been set null. In practice every pool retained in the set passed this check, so there are no null coordinates. Nominatim was used as a spot-check where Overpass was ambiguous (e.g. Nyéki Imre, where two nearby bus-stop nodes share the pool's name and had to be discarded).

LANE COUNTS follow the same rule and DO have nulls. A lane count was recorded only when an operator (or the operator's own schedule grid) states it in words or enumerates the lanes — 'hatpályás', '6 sávos', or a 'Sáv 1..7' header row. Where only a basin width was published, lanes were left null even when the conventional layout is obvious: an 11 m wide pool is normally 5 lanes, but that is inference, not a source. Learner pools (tanmedence) almost never have a published lane count and are mostly null by nature. The one place a secondary source asserts a lane count that could not be confirmed (Halassy Olivér, '6 sávos') it is recorded as hearsay in `notes` and the field is null.

THREE SCHEDULE ENCODINGS EXIST IN THE WILD, in descending order of usefulness to the app:

(1) HTML TABLE WITH AN INTEGER FREE-LANE COUNT — the jackpot, because the cell value IS the quantity the app needs. Three pools: Erzsébetligeti Rátonyi Gábor Uszoda (XVI), Szentmihályi Konrád Ferenc Uszoda (XVI) and Pesterzsébeti Uszoda (XX). The two XVI. kerület pools share an operator (Kertvárosi Sportlétesítményeket Üzemeltető Kft.) and a CMS, so ONE PARSER HANDLES BOTH: fetch '?content=dct&did=NN' where NN is found by scraping the nav for the anchor text 'Szabad pályák a közönségnek' (did=36 at Erzsébetliget, did=34 at Szentmihály — do not hardcode), skip the 4 chrome tables, select the table whose caption contains 'Közönség részére szabad sávok száma az úszómedencében', read columns H|K|Sz|Cs|P|Szo|V and 32 half-hour rows '6:00 - 6:30'..'21:00 - 21:30', and each cell is an integer count of free public lanes or 'X' for closed. Erzsébetliget additionally has a second table for the tanmedence whose cells are 'i'/blank (boolean, NOT a count); Szentmihály has no such table, so the parser must tolerate its absence.

Pesterzsébet (XX) is a DIFFERENT html-table shape and needs its own parser: server-rendered <table>s live at /melyvizes-medence/ and /tanmedence/ (the /savbeosztas/ page is only a chooser), six tables per page = Monday..Saturday with NO SUNDAY table even though the pool opens on Sundays, the header row enumerates '0.pálya'..'9.pálya' for the 10-lane deep pool and '5.pálya'..'1. pálya' (REVERSED) for the 5-lane tanmedence, an empty cell means free, and the words 'foglalt' / 'iskola' / 'iskolai-óvodai oktatás' mean occupied. CRITICAL GOTCHA: the cells use colspan, so naive <td> counting mis-aligns lanes.

(2) PDF GRID — seven pools, but in TWO FLAVOURS that must not be confused. The easier flavour is the Városgazda XVIII. Nonprofit Zrt. family (Bókay-park, Kastélydombi, Vilmos Endre), which shares ONE template across all three pools: URL pattern .../wp-content/uploads/<YYYY>/<MM>/<YYYY>-HL-{PU|KU|VE}-<YYYY>-<MONTH>-<start>-<end>.pdf, 2 pages (délelőtt / délután), A4 landscape, and a REAL TEXT LAYER that PyMuPDF reads directly — occupied cells carry both a fill colour AND the time-range text, free cells are white and empty, so colour decoding is optional here. Columns are 15-minute slots 6:00-12:45 and 13:00-20:45; rows are 7 day blocks x N lane rows (4 at Bókay and Kastélydomb, 6 at Vilmos Endre). Two gotchas: a coloured rectangle can span several lane rows vertically, and day names are stored letter-per-line and must be rejoined. Full-day closures appear as a purple band across all lanes.

The harder flavour is the rest (Újhegyi X, Csepeli Strandfürdő XXI, TVE Sportuszoda III, Csillaghegyi Árpád Forrásfürdő III), WHERE OCCUPANCY IS ENCODED PURELY AS CELL FILL COLOUR. These have NO usable text layer for the occupancy state: page.get_text() returns the day names, lane numbers and hour labels but the free/occupied state lives only in the rectangle fills. The working recipe is PyMuPDF — page.get_text('words') plus x/y bucketing to rebuild the grid, then page.get_drawings() to read each cell's fill RGB, then match those RGBs to the legend swatches printed on the page (and DROP the legend swatches themselves, which otherwise pollute the grid — at Újhegyi they sit at x0~16, x1~97, y~398-453). Exact observed RGB triples are recorded per pool in each scheduleSource.note so a scraper does not have to rediscover them. Two different semantics are in use: Újhegyi paints state directly (amber 1.0,0.75,0.0 = FOGLALT, green 0.0,0.69,0.31 = SZABAD), whereas Csepel paints the OCCUPYING CLUB's colour and leaves public slots unfilled, so free lanes = total lanes minus filled cells. Filenames encode the season and WILL change at the season turn — always scrape the parent 'Pályabeosztás' page for href$='.pdf' rather than hardcoding a URL.

(3) IMAGE (PNG/JPG) — two pools (Kispesti XIX, Hajós Alfréd Tanuszoda Budafok XXII). Kispest is the better of the two: a stable upload-path pattern .../wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/Savbeosztas-WEB-YYYY.MM.DD-MM.DD.png, two week panels, 'Medence 33 M' over 'Tanmedence', Sáv/Lane 1-6 per day (42 columns), hourly rows 06:00-21:00, GREEN = 'Lakosság számára elérhető', RED = 'Foglalt / Zárva'. These need OCR or manual transcription; treat as a weekly manual-refresh source.

AND THE REST PUBLISH NOTHING. Six pools are 'none-found' or 'facebook-only'. This is not always laziness on the operator's part — several genuinely allocate lanes only on a whiteboard at the ticket desk (Gazdagréti explicitly tells visitors to consult 'a jegypénztárnál elhelyezett foglaltsági tájékoztató').

TRAPS WORTH KNOWING. (a) Aggregator sites are wrong often enough to be dangerous: strand.hu gives Újhegyi's postcode as 1196, which is Kispest; the correct code is 1108. Always prefer OSM addr:* plus the operator's own contact page. (b) sport.ujbuda.hu (Nyéki Imre) is a Vite/React SPA serving a 2 KB JS shell — curl gets nothing. The content is reachable as JSON from https://api.ujbuda.hu/webapi/v1.0/static-pages/156 BUT ONLY with the header 'Domain: sport.ujbuda.hu'; without it the API answers {"error":{"code":10002,"message":"Invalid domain"}}. Resolve the numeric id from /webapi/v1.0/sitemap rather than hardcoding. (c) haloujpest.hu (Újpest) returns HTTP 403 with a JS 'Hitelesítés' anti-bot interstitial to every request regardless of headers — that pool is blocked, not schedule-less, and deserves a retry with a headless browser. www.varosgazda18.hu (the three XVIII. kerület pools) likewise returns 403 to curl and other scripted clients no matter what User-Agent is sent; its PDFs were only obtainable through a browser-like fetcher, so plan for a headless browser there too. (c2) esmtkuszoda-pesterzsebet.hu, the Pesterzsébet domain named in the brief, is DEAD — it now resolves to shared hosting whose TLS certificate covers unrelated domains; the live operator site is https://www.pesterzsebetiuszoda.hu/. (d) Several sites (uszodak16.hu, hegyvideksport.hu, sport13.hu, api.ujbuda.hu) intermittently return HTTP 000 / empty bodies; a 4x retry loop with a 3 s backoff fixed it. (e) A JPG named 'uszoda-palyarendszabalyok.jpg' on the BVSC site looks exactly like a lane schedule from its filename but is a trilingual spectator ground-rules poster — it was downloaded and viewed before being used, which is the only way to be sure. (f) Hungarian-language queries ('sávbeosztás', 'pályabeosztás', 'szabad pályák', 'vízfelület beosztás') find these pages; English ones do not.

SEASONAL CONTEXT AS OF 2026-09-24: the outdoor season has just ended. Szentmihály banners 'A kültéri medencéink bezártak!', the Erzsébetligeti strand closed 2026-08-31, and Csepel has switched to its winter timetable. Any summer/outdoor basin in this file should be treated as currently closed, and the 'strand' opening hours in openingHours are the summer figures recorded for completeness.
unresolved: Halassy Olivér Városi Uszoda (IV) — INCLUDED but with confidence 'low'. haloujpest.hu answers every request with HTTP 403 and a JS 'Hitelesítés / Verification' interstitial; reproduced with desktop-Chrome and Safari user agents, hu-HU Accept-Language and Sec-Fetch-* headers, over https and www; plain http does not answer at all. WebFetch separately refused the host. Lane count therefore null (secondary sources claim 6) and opening hours are taken from the OSM opening_hours tag and disagree with two secondary sources about the weekend. HIGHEST-VALUE RETRY TARGET: a headless browser that executes the challenge JS will almost certainly get in.

Nyéki Imre Uszoda (XI) — basin lengths and lane counts all null; the operator publishes only the three basin NAMES (Tanmedence, Nagymedence kint, Nagymedence bent). The PÁLYAFOGLALTSÁG section of the CMS payload, which normally carries the lane grids (blue cells = occupied), is EMPTY as of 2026-09-24 — the markup after each of the three labels is bare
. Re-poll api.ujbuda.hu/webapi/v1.0/static-pages/156 (with the Domain header) periodically; this pool could jump straight to a usable source when the operator re-uploads. Also: the official opening-hours block SILENTLY OMITS FRIDAY, so no weekday-5 entry was emitted.

BVSC-Zugló Laky Károly Sportuszoda (XIV) — lane counts null for all three basins and format 'none-found'. The site has a page literally called 'uszoda-medence-beosztas' but it publishes no grid; the only linked image is the spectator ground-rules poster. The házirend does state that the teaching basins are closed to the public on weekdays, which is useful negative information. A major club pool with a real internal allocation that simply is not published.

Újlak Uszoda és Strandfürdő (XVII) — lane count null. All eight site pages were enumerated; there is no sávbeosztás page, PDF or image. The árlista prices lane rental at 12 100 Ft/60 min and the házirend regulates per-lane group sizes, so an allocation demonstrably exists internally. Basin is 25 x 11 m (5 lanes would be the conventional layout, NOT recorded as it is inference).

Szérűskert Tanuszoda (III) — lane count null, nothing published. Note for the schema consumer: this is the one pool with TWO openingHours entries for the same weekday (a morning and an afternoon block with a midday closure); any consumer that assumes one row per weekday will mis-handle it.

Semmelweis Egyetem rehabilitációs klinika uszoda (XII, not VIII/IX as the brief's university hint suggested) — lane count null, no public schedule. This is a clinical/rehabilitation pool rather than a general-access public pool; include in the app only with a clear access caveat.

Gazdagréti Tanuszoda (XI) — lane count IS verified (6, 'hatpályás') but the free-water information is published ONLY as ad-hoc Facebook posts, by the operator's own explicit statement on nsu.hu. There is no structured recurring table anywhere. Additionally, weekdays 08:00-16:00 are given over entirely to compulsory school and kindergarten lessons, so public availability is effectively zero in that window even though the building is open — the app should special-case this.

Nővér utcai Tanuszoda (XIII) — DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED from pools[]. The operator states twice on its own page: 'Az uszoda nem nyilvános fürdő, csak gyermek úszóoktatási tevékenységre alkalmas.' It is a 12,5 x 6 m Stilianos-branded learner pool for children's lessons with no public lane swimming at all, so it has no free-lane concept. (Address discrepancy noted for anyone who revisits it: the operator prints 1138 Nővér utca 15 while OSM tags 1131.)

Molnár Ferenc uszoda (IX) — investigated and NOT given a record. It is the school pool of the Molnár Ferenc Magyar-Angol Két Tanítási Nyelvű Általános Iskola, renovated by the Belső-Pesti Tankerületi Központ. No operator site publishes opening hours, prices or a lane schedule; the school's own domain redirects. Would need a phone call.

FTC / Fradi Népligeti uszoda (IX) — investigated and NOT given a record. fradi.hu treats the Népligeti Sportközpont as a club training facility and refers all facility questions to the üzemeltetési igazgatóság; the swimming-section page covers paid courses only. No public lane schedule exists online, and the site has been under redevelopment. (Also note it is usually indexed under X. kerület, Vajda Péter utca, not IX.)

LoBoGó Tanuszoda (1098 Lobogó utca 1, IX) — identified via OSM (operator uszasoktatas.com) but NOT given a record: it presents as a private swim-school teaching pool and no public közönségúszás lane schedule was found. Worth a second look if IX. kerület coverage matters, since it is the only real pool candidate found in that district.

Kelenvölgyi uszoda (XI) — the brief listed 'Gazdagréti és Kelenvölgyi' as a pair, but no Kelenvölgy swimming pool could be found in OSM, on nsu.hu or anywhere else. Most likely it does not exist (Kelenvölgy has a sports ground, not a pool).

Csepeli Sport- és Szabadidőközpont (XXI) — PREMISE ERROR IN THE BRIEF. The facility at Hollandi út 8-10, reopened 2023-07-01 as the Kolonics György Szabadidőközpont, HAS NO POOL: it is tennis courts, padel courts and a small artificial-turf pitch. The actual Csepel public pool is the Csepeli Strandfürdő two doors down at Hollandi út 14, which is what was recorded. A separate small Csepeli Tanuszoda also exists at 1211 Tanműhely köz 2 (operator varosgazda.eu) and was NOT researched.

Marczibányi téri uszoda and Pasaréti uszoda (II) — searched for and not found as public swimming pools; the II. kerület candidates in the brief appear not to exist in that form. No II. kerület pool is represented in this file.

BME sportuszoda and ELTE uszoda — do not exist as separate public pools. Both universities use Tüskecsarnok, which is explicitly out of scope (colleague's set). The only university pool found was the Semmelweis clinical pool above.

Soroksár (XXIII) — CONFIRMED NO POOL. The district's own sports concept lists an uszoda as one of the two basic facilities MISSING from its infrastructure; residents swim in neighbouring districts (Kastélydombi, Kispest, Pesterzsébet). Nothing to record.
Zugló (XIV) — the only real pool is BVSC's Laky Károly Sportuszoda, already recorded. No separate district-council-run Zugló pool was found.

Hegyvidéki Sport Uszoda (XII) — NOT RESEARCHED. hegyvideksport.hu returned intermittent empty responses and time ran out before it could be covered. This is the clearest remaining coverage gap and should be the first target of any follow-up pass.

Vilmos Endre Uszoda (XVIII) — IS CLOSED AS THIS FILE IS WRITTEN. Shut since 2026-05-01 for renovation; the operator states it reopens 2026-09-26 at 06:00, two days after this research. Its published lane PDF is still the April edition and shows an open-ended purple 'KARBANTARTÁS, FELÚJÍTÁS 2026 MÁJUS 1 –' band across every lane, so the schedule data is stale by construction. Confidence medium. THE APP MUST NOT ROUTE USERS THERE BEFORE 2026-09-26, and the PDF should be re-fetched after that date.

Gloriett Sportuszoda (XVIII) — DOES NOT EXIST. Confirmed four independent ways: the Városgazda XVIII. Nonprofit Zrt. facility list, the 18.kerulet.ittlakunk.hu 'uszoda, fürdő' category, akademia18.hu/uszasoktatas (which lists only Bókay and Kastélydomb as venues), and an Overpass sweep of the south-east Budapest bbox. The XVIII. kerület has exactly three pools, all recorded here. 'Gloriett' in that district is a housing estate, a sports primary school and a sports club — none has a pool.

Pestszentimrei Sportkastély (1188 Kisfaludy u. 33/c, XVIII) — EXISTS BUT HAS NO POOL. The operator page lists handball, multi-sport, table tennis and artificial turf; OSM tags it sport=volleyball;basketball;handball;team_handball;table_tennis. Not a swimming venue, so no record was written. The brief's 'Pestszentimrei' candidate is best served by the Vilmos Endre Uszoda, which IS in Pestszentimre and is recorded.

Kastélydombi Uszoda (XVIII) — lane count (4) is solid, taken from the official PDF, but the basin size 20x9 m rests on a single secondary source (18.kerulet.ittlakunk.hu); the operator page gives only the 1.40 m depth. Also a policy note the app should honour: NO FREE PUBLIC LANE weekdays 14:00-19:00 by design.

Hajós Alfréd Tanuszoda, Budatétény (XXII) — OPENING HOURS CONFLICT, unresolved. The /nyitvatartas-2/ image (dated April 2025) gives weekday 06:00-14:00 and 18:15-20:30, weekend 08:00-18:30, while the newer 2026-09-01 lane sheet gives 06:00-13:30 and 18:15-20:00, weekend 08:00-18:00. The dedicated hours page was recorded and the conflict flagged. No lane count is published for its tanmedence (null). NOTE: this is NOT the Margitsziget Hajós Alfréd (which is the colleague's scope) — it is a small Budatétény teaching pool run by HÓFEHÉR FÓKA Bt., confirmed via its own contact page and a distinct OSM object.

Pesterzsébeti Uszoda (XX) — two gaps in an otherwise excellent source. (1) Weekend closing time conflicts: /melyvizes-medence/ says Sat/Sun close at 14:00 while /kapcsolat/, /savbeosztas/ and /tanmedence/ say 18:00; 18:00 was used (majority, and backed by the detailed cashier-closing text) and flagged. (2) NO SUNDAY LANE TABLE is published at all even though the pool opens on Sundays, so Sunday free-lane data simply does not exist upstream.

Bókay-park (XVIII) — no lane count published for the outdoor 25x11 m pool or the pancsoló, so both are null; only the indoor pool's 4 lanes are verified. The outdoor pool and pancsoló have been closed for the season since 2026-08-31. Phone numbers differ between OSM (stale landlines) and the operator page for both Bókay and Kastélydomb; the operator-page numbers were used and both are documented in the records.
Kőbányai Sportközpont beyond Újhegyi (X) — partially covered; any pool in that district not present in pools[] was not reached.

BUILD-SAFETY CHECK (for the build script that drops pools with no basins): NO POOL IN THIS FILE HAS AN EMPTY basins ARRAY — all 19 have at least one basin object, so none will silently vanish. 42 basin objects in total. However SIX POOLS HAVE NO VERIFIED LANE COUNT ON ANY BASIN (every lanes field is null): szeruskert-tanuszoda, halassy-oliver-varosi-uszoda, nyeki-imre-uszoda, semmelweis-rehabilitacios-klinika-uszoda, bvsc-laky-karoly-sportuszoda, ujlak-uszoda. These are real, correctly-located pools that belong in the app, but the free-lane feature cannot compute a denominator for them — the UI should show them as 'lane count unknown' rather than treating null as zero. Each one's individual reason is listed separately above.

GENERAL: 'indoor' is the softest field in this dataset. For strand-type venues that operate year-round with heated water (notably Csepeli Strandfürdő) no explicit statement of whether the basin is covered in winter could be found, so indoor was set false on the strandfürdő designation alone. Verify before relying on it.
